items.ico-ai-guidance::dpia: Organisations using AI systems that process personal data must conduct Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) to identify and mitigate data protection risks.
items.ico-ai-guidance::automated-decision-maki: UK GDPR Article 22 applies to wholly automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects: right to human review and meaningful information about the logic involved, including the right to obtain human intervention.
items.ico-ai-guidance::transparency: Organisations must be transparent about using AI to process personal data, including telling data subjects clearly how automated decision-making affects them.
items.ico-ai-guidance::bias-and-fairness: AI systems that process personal data must be designed and operated to avoid bias and ensure fair treatment, consistent with the data protection principles.
